_comment: Single source of truth for everything price- and trial-related on the website. Edit this file and redeploy - no component changes needed.

trial.label: 21-day trial
trial.note: Full functionality for 21 days, no card and no auto-renewal. The evaluation key is issued with an expiry date and can be extended once by agreement.

intro: All prices are net, in EUR, excluding VAT. Every tier is self-hosted on your own infrastructure.
tiersNote: * Running tests in parallel requires a Docker daemon the runner can reach - each run then gets a container of its own. Without one vallus still runs every suite, one at a time.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.summary: For small teams and evaluation - the core runner at no cost.
points: Full core runner: workflows, scheduling, reports

tiers.name: Team
tiers.summary: A single QA team putting its first suites behind a dashboard.
points: Up to 3 projects in the launcher
2 test runs in parallel per project*, more available as an add-on
All releases during the term included

tiers.name: Business
tiers.summary: Several teams sharing one instance, with Jira/Xray in the loop.
points: 5 test runs in parallel per project*, more available as an add-on
Everything in Team, plus Jira and Xray integration

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.summary: Organisation-wide rollout with an SLA and an agreed backlog.
points: Unlimited parallel test runs*, no licence ceiling
Custom integrations scoped with your team

sourceLicense.title: Commercial source license
sourceLicense.body: A perpetual, non-exclusive license with full source access and the right to modify the code for internal use - for organisations that need independence from the vendor, a code audit, or source escrow. One-time fee, first 12 months of maintenance included, 20% per year thereafter. Subscription fees paid in the first 24 months are credited in full against it.

addOns.name: Additional parallel test run (per project)
addOns.note: Parallel runs need a Docker daemon the runner can reach, so each run gets a container of its own. Without one vallus still runs every suite, one at a time.

services.name: Offline installation package (one platform, one version)
Rebuild of the offline package for a new version
services.note: Or included for the subscription term.
